title: Do Persona-Infused LLMs Affect Performance in a Strategic Reasoning Game?
summary: Tests whether persona prompts affect strategic play in PERIL. A psychometric translation step maps personality-inventory responses into game heuristics, making it possible to compare persona-conditioned strategies with manually chosen ones.

title: Curiosity Exploration Styles in Word Association Tasks
venue: Proceedings of the 47th Annual Meeting of the Cognitive Science Society (CogSci)
summary: Uses semantic graphs to study exploration styles across Chain Free Association and Semantic Fluency tasks. The results identify cross-task patterns in some graph features and provide evidence for the dancer exploration style.

title: A survey of fatigue measures and models
venue: The Journal of Defense Modeling and Simulation, 22(2)
note: First published online in March 2023; journal issue published in April 2025.
summary: Reviews behavioral, physiological, and cognitive approaches to measuring and modeling fatigue, with attention to model selection and opportunities for combining multiple kinds of evidence.

title: Shot Selection to Determine Legality of Actions in a Rule-Heavy Environment
summary: Studies example selection for determining whether proposed actions are legal in an environment governed by a detailed set of rules.

title: AMHR COLIEE 2024 Entry: Legal Entailment and Retrieval
venue: New Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence, JSAI-isAI 2024, LNCS 14741
summary: Presents the AMHR team's approaches to legal case entailment, statute retrieval, and textual entailment. The team's monoT5 approach with hard-negative mining won Task 2 of COLIEE 2024.

title: Exploring Prompting Approaches in Legal Textual Entailment
summary: Evaluates retrieval-based prompting and model ensembles for COLIEE 2023 legal textual entailment, using GPT-4 and Flan-T5 without task-specific fine-tuning.

title: Enforcing Grammar in Code Synthesis with Transformers
summary: Introduces a grammar-enforcement layer for transformer code generation and evaluates syntactic correctness and exact-match behavior on the Hearthstone dataset.
